entities.summary: Severiano Martínez Anido was a Spanish general who served in a number of government posts in Spain during the Primo de Rivera and Francoist dictatorships. He became known for the violent repression of the labor movement in Barcelona during the years of pistolerismo.

entities.summary: Severiano Martínez Anido was a Spanish general who served in a number of government posts in Spain during the Primo de Rivera and Francoist dictatorships. He became known for the violent repression of the labor movement in Barcelona during the years of pistolerismo.
